title: C: String Basics
description: Work with C strings: declare a char array, print it, find its length, and concatenate two strings.

steps.title: String Declaration and Print
steps.description: Declare `char name[] = "C Programming"` and print it. Then print its length using `strlen()`. Include <string.h>.
hints: Strings in C are null-terminated char arrays.
`strlen()` returns the length excluding null terminator.

verification.failureMessage: Print the string and its length
